text:
Maya: Flagging a new mobile regression — on small widths the runs table shows a horizontal scroll and action buttons are off-screen when the right rail slides in. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/shot1
Ben: Repro on iPhone SE emulator. The table keeps min-width for columns so it overflows instead of collapsing.
Tess: Proposal: below 360px switch to a compact single-column list (cards). Above 360 keep condensed table. That avoids hidden actions.
Maya: Product wants quick affordance: if we keep table for 360-420, add a sticky "•••" actions column so CTAs remain reachable.
Ben: Implementation note: avoid 100vh for scroll containers (keyboard/foldables). Use JS-set --vh from visualViewport.height or update after sidebar animation: requestAnimationFrame(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')));
a11y-bot: Accessibility: ensure sidebar traps focus and set aria-hidden on background content. For compact cards, include clear labels (Status:, Model:, Cost:) and verify contrast on status pills.
Tess: I'll prototype compact cards + sticky actions column + fix for vh. Will include before/after screenshots and an a11y checklist in PR.
ci-bot: queued pipeline for branch "feat/mobile-compact-actions". Job id: 4921.
Maya: Thanks team — tagging design for a quick thumbs-up.
